IDGL.split: official Planetoid Cora split in the repository data loader

Pro-GNN.launcher_correction: The checked-in shell uses --epoch, but train.py defines --epochs; invoke the parser's accepted spelling while preserving the intended 1000-epoch setting.

relation_probe.source: argmax of full-node logits from each selected official checkpoint
relation_probe.kernel: row-normalize the exact nonnegative aggregation relation used at evaluation
relation_probe.normal_performance_gate: official test accuracy is reported separately and must be checked against the paper/repository protocol before relation claims are promoted

inference_limit: This is a frozen learned-relation probe. Only the one-step argmax is equivalent to one nonnegative aggregation of the hard source labels; K powers are a diagnostic stress test, not the official nonlinear GNN forward pass.
seed_reduction_rule: If the third seed cannot be completed within the practical runtime, retain all completed runs, report the reduced n, and make no population-level uncertainty claim.
test_label_use: test labels are used only to score correction and harmful-change outcomes; never for training, tuning, model selection, threshold choice or audit filtering

execution.seed_reduction: Only the prespecified reference run was completed for each method because Pro-GNN required 12,737 seconds for 1,000 epochs. No multi-seed or population-level uncertainty claim is made.
